scope: Live 0.7.273 server with initial visibility client corrections; agent-owned Distant Heights; 20 s walking out and back. Browser event timestamps have millisecond resolution. Network time includes websocket endpoint and owner processing; not a raw packet RTT.
observations: 315 complete chunk exchanges; no terrain root hidden in 392 rendered frames. Most measured delay is after acknowledgement, not geometry verification/installation. This motivates removing per-chunk stop-and-wait, without claiming to isolate every network/owner contribution.
